God, I ask You in Jesus' name bless me to know, trust, and love You with all my heart, soul, mind, and strength. Let me draw as close to You as You will allow me to and consume and nestle me in the chambers of Your heart. Bless me with the desire, strength, and spirit of obedience to always respect You and obey Your Word and will for my life. Bless me to live my life for Your glory, approval, and applause. Bless me with love, power, and a sound mind. Bless me to always operate with a "God Solution Focused Heart, Mind, Spirit, and Attitude." Bless me to prosper, have excellent health, and never stop growing in the grace and knowledge of Christ Jesus. Bless me with a keen acute gift of discernment and a wise and understanding heart. God be with me as a mighty warrior. Let no weapon formed against me prosper. God, cover me and cover me in the prayers of the righteous. God, please do the same for the writer of this prayer and all those who love and care about me. God forever honor this prayer over each of each of our lives. Thank You, Jesus. Amen.

Hey Rachel! Just wanted to let you know that God has heard your prayers today. Help is on the way. He will walk you through school. He will hold your hand all the way through it, even when it’s hard. Remember that God is always proud of you, regardless of how you perform or the mistakes you make. 
For your fiancé, he will find his way out. He is not too far gone. Even in his darkness moments, God is waiting at the other side. The enemy will never win. God will come out on top and heal your fiancé. 
Stay strong Rachel. Believe even when there is no reason to believe. God loves you very much. I hope you have a great rest of your day!

Hi sweetheart, just prayed for you. I hope you know that behind the screen are real brothers and sisters in Christ interceding in prayer for you, covering you in the blood of Christ and placing our hopes in God to move in your situation. It is not hopeless or the end for you. Every tough time bears fruit, every obstacle has a meaning when we are walking in the Lord. He sees you and  your cries. You are not alone, there is a good plan for your life. Keep the faith and keep going, I can only imagine the burdens you are carrying. We have a God who carrries us when our feet fail, I am sure that He will be there to carry you too. I hope you continue to surrender, and I pray that God renews your spirit with hope, joy, love and support. With all my love, a random person on the internet who felt called to pour into you.
Praying for you Rachel 🙏
